### Lake Worth Police + Safety Cloud®: Extending the Reach of Red and Blue Lights

The Lake Worth Police Department may be small in size, but it’s just as busy as any large department.

An average of 400,000 cars drive through Lake Worth every day, adding up to 146 million vehicles every year. This influx of vehicles keeps the department busy, but has also brought tragedy.

In August 2024, Sergeant Billy Randolph of the neighboring Fort Worth Department was struck and killed at a crash scene on I-35. With that tragedy in mind and the sobering reminder of how dangerous responding on the road is, the Lake Worth Police Department sought out Safety Cloud® to better protect officers on the road.

Read the Lake Worth Police Department case study to learn how the department added additional protection for their officers, including key details on:

- Easily implementing digital alerting on any police vehicle
- Safety Cloud sending out alerts only when an officer is actively responding
- Improving Move Over law compliance
